is_anopheles.evidence: Principal vectors are Anopheles funestus s.s., An. gambiae s.s., and Anopheles arabiensis (p. 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Molecular assays identified An. gambiae complex [26] and An. funestus complex [27] species (p. 3). No genotyping of field populations for resistance markers is reported.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies are provided for field-collected mosquitoes.

african_field_population.evidence: This study was conducted in Bar Olengo location... Siaya County, Kenya (p. 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: A longitudinal two-arm evaluation study was conducted between June and November 2024 (p. 3).

sub_country_location.evidence: Bar Olengo location (- 0.0728262°N, 34.6699246°E), Bondo sub-county, Siaya County, Kenya (p. 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine new collections for an IRS evaluation study.

supplement.evidence: The paper provides all relevant data in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the residual efficacy of VECTRON T500 (broflanilide) for indoor residual spraying in Siaya County, Kenya. While the study includes bioassays on field-collected Anopheles and uses a resistant laboratory strain (Bungoma) characterized by kdr and ace-1 mutations, it does not provide genotype data for these or any other resistance markers in the field populations.
exclusion_reasons: The study does not report genotype data (counts or frequencies) for insecticide resistance markers in field-collected mosquitoes. Molecular analysis was limited to species identification.
